findings.title: Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints POST /orders, POST /orders/:id/refund, and POST /orders/:id/cancel lack idempotency key support. The refund endpoint explicitly risks double-refunding on retry.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists for any write operation. Agent retries or LLM duplicate tool calls will create duplicate orders, issue double refunds, or trigger duplicate warehouse cancellations.
findings.recommendation: Add Idempotency-Key header support to POST /orders and POST /orders/:id/refund using a deduplication table or cache with TTL.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND write endpoints lack idempotency keys.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: POST /orders/:id/refund explicitly risks double-refunding. Agent retries at machine speed create data integrity risk.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add Idempotency-Key header support with deduplication table.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints enforce idempotency; duplicate requests return original response.

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No application-level audit logging exists. Write operations do not log the authenticated principal, action taken, or affected resource. CloudWatch logs configured but no structured audit events emitted.
findings.gap: Cannot attribute any write action to a specific agent or user identity. No tamper-evident audit trail for compliance or forensics.
findings.recommendation: Add structured audit log emission on every write operation capturing: principal (from JWT), action, resource_id, timestamp, and outcome. Store in immutable log (S3 Object Lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents performing irreversible operations (refund, delete, cancel) require immutable audit trails for compliance and forensics.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add structured audit log emission on every write operation.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit trail capturing authenticated principal for every state-mutating operation.

findings.title: Compensation and Rollback
findings.description: All three write operations are explicitly irreversible: hardDelete removes the row permanently, refund issues real money movement, cancelAndRecallShipment triggers physical warehouse dispatch recall. No saga pattern, no compensating transactions, no undo endpoints.
findings.gap: An agent executing a multi-step workflow that fails mid-sequence leaves the system in an unrecoverable partial state. No rollback or compensation mechanism exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement soft-delete for orders. Add idempotency to refund. Implement saga pattern with compensating transactions for multi-step operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND all write operations are irreversible with no compensation.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Hard delete, refund, and cancel are explicitly noted as irreversible in code comments. No undo mechanism exists.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement soft-delete for orders (status='deleted' instead of row removal).
blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern with compensating transactions; soft-delete with retention; refund reversals.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: System stores customer PII (customerId) and financial data (totalCents). GET /orders/:id uses SELECT * returning all columns without field filtering. No DTOs or field-level exclusion. Single orders:write role grants access to all data.
findings.gap: Agent-facing API returns all database fields including PII without scoping. No access control differentiates sensitive from non-sensitive data access.
findings.recommendation: Replace SELECT * with explicit column selection excluding PII. Create separate authorized endpoints for PII access. Add OAuth scopes for data-domain differentiation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive fields returned in API responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Code comments confirm PII in orders table. SELECT * returns all fields. No field filtering for agent-facing responses.

b1.reasoning: SELECT * returns all fields including PII. No DTOs or field exclusion. agent_scope=write-enabled.

b2.reasoning: Single orders:write role grants access to all data. No differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive access.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata (tags, annotations, or Macie integration).

blocker_remediation.immediate: Replace SELECT * with explicit column selection excluding PII fields.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Field-level response filtering with separate OAuth scopes for PII access.

findings.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
findings.description: Customer PII and financial data stored in RDS with no documented residency controls. No GDPR/LGPD compliance references. No region-specific data controls. CloudFormation deploys to AWS::Region but imposes no cross-region constraints.
findings.gap: No documented data residency policy, no technical controls preventing cross-region data transmission for customer financial/PII data.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Add region-restriction tags to IaC resources. Implement VPC endpoints for LLM APIs ensuring data stays in-region.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND customer financial/PII data has no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Service stores customer IDs and financial amounts. An agent transmitting this data to an LLM in a different jurisdiction has no documented controls to prevent compliance violation.

findings.title: Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization uses orders:read and orders:write roles. All write operations share a single role. An agent authorized to create orders inherits ability to hard-delete, refund, and cancel.
findings.gap: No action-level granularity within write operations. Cannot grant create without also granting delete and refund.
findings.recommendation: Split orders:write into granular roles: orders:create, orders:delete, orders:refund, orders:cancel.

compensating_controls: Implement orchestration-layer permission scoping at API Gateway level
Add application-level sub-claims within orders:write role

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: JWT verified but no on-behalf-of flow. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user. No identity propagation to downstream warehouse calls.
findings.gap: No identity propagation to downstream services. Cannot attribute warehouse operations to originating user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange for agent-on-behalf-of-user operations. Propagate user identity to warehouse calls.

compensating_controls: Require agent-initiated requests to include user-context claim in JWT
Add request correlation headers to downstream calls

findings.title: Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: Authentication relies entirely on external JWKS JWT verification. No application-level token blocklist or identity suspension mechanism.
findings.gap: Cannot immediately block a compromised agent identity at the application layer.
findings.recommendation: Add token/principal blocklist middleware with Redis-backed cache. Expose admin endpoint to add principals to blocklist.

compensating_controls: Use short-lived JWT tokens (5-minute expiry)
Implement token blocklist cache

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, ETag support, or conditional updates. UPDATE statements execute without checking current state.
findings.gap: Race conditions between concurrent agent instances will corrupt order state.
findings.recommendation: Add version column with optimistic locking. Return 409 Conflict on version mismatch.

compensating_controls: Add version column with WHERE clause on UPDATE
Use SELECT FOR UPDATE on critical transitions

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: OrderService calls external WarehouseClient with no circuit breaker, no retry logic, no timeout configuration, and no fallback handling.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns on external dependency calls. Runaway agent loops cascade failures to warehouse.
findings.recommendation: Add circuit breaker library (opossum) around WarehouseClient calls. Configure timeouts and retry with backoff.

compensating_controls: Add HTTP client timeouts on warehouse calls
Implement circuit breaker at infrastructure level

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no application-level rate limiting middleware, no WAF rules.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms overwhelming the service.
findings.recommendation: Add @fastify/rate-limit middleware. Deploy API Gateway with throttling for production.

compensating_controls: Add @fastify/rate-limit for immediate protection
Deploy API Gateway with usage plans

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No business-domain transaction limits. Agent could issue unlimited refunds, delete unlimited orders, or cancel unlimited shipments without per-session or per-hour caps.
findings.gap: Agent error blast radius is unbounded. No configurable limits on business impact of agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Add per-caller transaction limits: max_refunds_per_hour, max_deletes_per_session, max_refund_amount_per_day.

compensating_controls: Implement per-caller refund caps at application level
Add bulk operation size limits on delete

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: Order status limited to placed/shipped/cancelled/refunded. No draft or pending_review state. All writes execute immediately and irrevocably.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent-proposed changes to await human approval before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add pending status values (pending_refund, pending_cancel) and confirm/reject endpoints.

compensating_controls: Add pending status values requiring explicit confirmation
Implement orchestration-layer approval gates

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow. High-risk operations (refund, cancel, delete) execute immediately without configurable approval step.
findings.gap: Cannot configure high-risk operations to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Add configurable approval gates for refund (amount threshold) and cancel (always for shipped orders).

compensating_controls: Implement Step Functions with human task tokens for refund/cancel
Add threshold-based approval triggers

findings.title: PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: CloudWatch logs configured but no PII redaction or log scrubbing. System handles customer PII with no log-level protection.
findings.gap: No PII redaction middleware or log scrubbing configuration.
findings.recommendation: Add structured logging configuration excluding sensitive fields. Integrate PII detection on CloudWatch log group.

compensating_controls: Configure Fastify logger to exclude request/response bodies
Add CloudWatch log subscription filter for PII detection

findings.title: Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification exists at openapi/orders.yaml but lacks request body and response body schemas. Only status codes and descriptions provided.
findings.gap: Spec is incomplete — no request/response schemas for automated agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Add request body schemas and response schemas using $ref components. Consider auto-generating from Fastify route schemas.

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Consistent {code, message} error structure present for 401, 403, and 404 responses. No retryable boolean or error category included.
findings.gap: Missing retryable/terminal distinction. Agents must guess whether to retry on failure.
findings.recommendation: Add retryable boolean and error category to error response format.

findings.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
findings.description: Request bodies cast without validation (req.body as Record<string, unknown>). No validation library in dependencies. Parameterized queries prevent SQL injection only.
findings.gap: No input validation at API boundary. Malformed agent payloads reach database layer.
findings.recommendation: Add typebox or zod schemas to Fastify route definitions with field-level validation.

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Order interface defines only id, customerId, status, totalCents. No created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No Cache-Control headers.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata on records. Agents cannot determine data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at columns. Include in API responses with Last-Modified header.

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: OpenAPI spec versioned (2.1.0) and node-pg-migrate for DB migrations present. No API URL versioning, no breaking change detection, no contract tests, no CI pipeline.
findings.gap: No API versioning strategy. Agent tool bindings could break silently on deployment.
findings.recommendation: Add URL-based API versioning. Add OpenAPI diff tools and consumer-driven contract tests.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry/X-Ray instrumentation. No structured logging. No correlation IDs. CloudWatch receives unstructured container stdout.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced through the system.
findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node with auto-instrumentation and Fastify request ID generation.

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms defined. No alerting thresholds for error rates or latency. No PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: Service degradation affecting agents goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for ALB 5XX count and target response time P99.

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists (infra/ecs.yaml) but no automated change review and no drift detection configured.
findings.gap: 1 of 3 governance sub-checks pass (IaC exists, but no review process or drift detection).
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with IaC plan review on PRs. Enable CloudFormation drift detection.

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists in the repository. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile, or buildspec.yml found.
findings.gap: No automated mechanism to detect API-breaking changes before production.
findings.recommendation: Create CI pipeline with lint, type-check, test, OpenAPI validation, and deployment gating.

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Vitest configured in package.json but no test files exist. Zero test coverage for API endpoints.
findings.gap: No automated tests for any API endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Create test files for all routes. Test error cases. Add to CI pipeline.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: RDS resource not defined in available CloudFormation template. No StorageEncrypted or KmsKeyId properties visible for the database storing customer data.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest configuration verifiable for customer data store.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with StorageEncrypted: true and customer-managed KMS key.

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment, docker-compose, seed data, or environment-specific configurations found.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL and seed data. Add staging environment parameter to CloudFormation.

findings.title: Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission or webhook support. State changes are persisted to database only, not published to any event bus.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to order state changes proactively without polling.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding SNS/EventBridge event publication on order status transitions.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. Agents have no visibility into consumption limits.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on rate limit awareness.
findings.recommendation: Add X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers once rate limiting is implemented.

findings.title: Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness monitoring. No database constraints beyond parameterized INSERT.
findings.gap: No signal about data completeness or quality for agent reasoning.
findings.recommendation: Add database constraints (NOT NULL, CHECK) and consider data quality monitoring.

findings.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or data dictionary describing the orders schema semantically.
findings.gap: No self-service discovery path for building agent tools.
findings.recommendation: Add schema documentation. Consider AWS Glue Data Catalog for the RDS database.

findings.title: Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. No order volume, refund rate, or cancellation rate tracking.
findings.gap: Cannot measure agent interaction business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Add custom CloudWatch metrics for order/refund/cancel volumes.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: REST API exposed via Fastify with OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification at openapi/orders.yaml.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: JSON responses (Fastify default) — standard structured format. Informational absence suppressed.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows.

evaluations.title: Machine Identity Authentication
evaluations.reason: JWT RS256 with JWKS, issuer/audience validation, and role claims supporting machine identity.

evaluations.title: Scoped Permissions
evaluations.reason: Authorization supports scoped permissions: orders:read (read-only) vs orders:write (write operations).

evaluations.title: Credential Management
evaluations.reason: Database credentials managed via AWS Secrets Manager with auto-generated passwords.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: GET /orders/:id returns current state with status field (placed/shipped/cancelled/refunded).

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority or critical path designation.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results (only single-item GET /orders/:id).

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful: customerId, totalCents, status (TypeScript); customer_id, total_cents (database).

evaluations.title: Rollback Capability
evaluations.reason: ECS DeploymentCircuitBreaker with Rollback: true configured in CloudFormation.

items.summary: Resolve all 5 BLOCKERs and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings to unblock agent pilot consideration.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings to improve agent effectiveness and operational readiness.
Address INFO findings and remaining quality improvements for optimal agent integration.

recommended_actions.action: Implement idempotency and compensation patterns for write operations
recommended_actions.rationale: Two BLOCKERs (API-Q4, STATE-Q1) are directly coupled: idempotency keys prevent duplicate writes, compensation enables rollback. Resolving both unlocks write-enabled agent safety.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy structured audit logging with immutable storage
recommended_actions.rationale: BLOCKER — compliance requirement for write-enabled agents. Cannot prove or disprove agent actions without audit trail.

recommended_actions.action: Implement field-level data scoping and residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Two BLOCKERs addressing data protection: field filtering prevents PII leakage, residency controls prevent cross-jurisdiction violations.

recommended_actions.action: Add rate limiting and transaction limits
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents runaway agent loops from overwhelming the service and limits blast radius of agent errors.

recommended_actions.action: Implement human-in-the-loop approval for high-risk operations
recommended_actions.rationale: Refund, cancel, and delete operations involve real money and physical actions. Draft states and approval gates provide defense in depth.
Foundation for deployment safety and agent-interaction debugging. Enables contract testing and performance monitoring.
